profile.summary: Men Creating Peace Counseling and Education LLC is a company that provides counseling and education focused on violence prevention and healthy relationships. It offers anger management and batterer's treatment classes, community education and individual counseling, mainly for men. It was founded in Oakland, California, and now operates from Olympia, Washington.
